Name: Florist Furniture and Winter Blooms
Author: farmerbeans
Description:
[size=3]For the flower-lovers! Build Florist shops and greenhouses with more flowers in the Furniture Catalog. Customizable via config or Generic Mod Options. [/size]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3]Content Patcher[/size]

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Adds 30+ new furniture items to the catalog, including Florist shelves, flowering houseplants and wall decor 
[*]Optional: Replaces the back-sides of end-tables with matching shop counters (obtained through the furniture catalog)
[*]Optional: Seasonal flowers and decorations bloom through winter (the decorations purchased at the night market)
[*]All pixel-art is based off of vanilla game sprites
[/list]
